title: Which control for the job?
intro: Eight situations from a working session — pick the control each one calls for.

cards.text: First launch in a codebase Claude has never seen
It used pip again — this is a uv project
It keeps forgetting the vector DB has two collections
Done with the bug fix; next task is a totally unrelated feature
Mid-task, the history is huge but you still need the thread
It's heading down the wrong path right now, mid-response
The change must touch exactly backend/search_tools.py and nothing else
A risky refactor — you want to review the approach before any code

debrief: Three families: memory controls make knowledge PERMANENT (/init for the whole map, # the moment a mistake repeats — not after the third time); context controls manage the CONVERSATION (/clear between tasks, /compact within one, ESC to interrupt, ESC ESC to rewind); precision controls sharpen the NEXT prompt (@ pins files, ! runs bash, plan mode buys a review before code exists). The classic misfile is c2/c3 into context: clearing doesn't fix a repeated error — teaching does.
